headline: No API changes break the bot today; the ideas check whether a red morning makes you trade bigger in the afternoon, measure volume against the same hour on past days, and show your odds of a 50% drawdown from your own trades.

ideas.title: Red-morning check: does a losing morning make your afternoon bigger?
ideas.why: A study of 150 prop day traders found they traded more and bigger after a losing morning, and the ones who did it most earned the least. /week would show your own afternoons after red vs green mornings; after a red morning the guard caps the afternoon at 2 trades and half size.

ideas.title: Volume spike measured against the same hour on past days
ideas.why: The scanner's volume spike compares the last 3 hours with the day before, so the busy hours always look like spikes. Comparing with the same hour over the last 7 days shows which movers have unusual volume right now, not just normal busy-hour volume.

ideas.title: Ruin odds from your own trades in /week
ideas.why: Replay your last 30 days of trades, as whole days so tilt streaks stay together, 10,000 times. /week shows your odds of losing half the account over the next 200 trades at your current size, at half size, and with the revenge trades removed.

sources.title: Garvey, Murphy & Wu (2005) – Do Losses Linger? Evidence from Proprietary Stock Traders
